captions_meta.li_hook: Four press release myths we still hear every week, and what the data actually says.
li_body: Most PR habits are inherited, not tested. Here are the four we see most often, checked against current sources:
li_points: "Press releases are dead." Cision's 2025 State of the Media found 72% of journalists call them the most useful resource PR teams provide.
"A longer pitch looks more serious." Muck Rack (2025): 69% of journalists prefer pitches under 200 words.
"Follow up daily to be sure." Same study: 50% say one follow-up is ideal, and 51% want it 3–7 days later.
"Releases are an SEO shortcut." Google's spam policies list optimized anchor text in distributed press releases as link spam.
captions_meta.li_close: Which myth was hardest to unlearn on your team?
